steps.code: pip install code-review-graph · pipx install code-review-graph

steps.en: Configure your AI tools and parse the repo
steps.zh: 配置你的 AI 工具并解析仓库

steps.en: Tree-sitter writes functions, calls and imports into a local SQLite graph
steps.zh: 解析函数与调用，写进本地 SQLite 图

steps.en: Leave watch mode or editor hooks running as you work
steps.zh: 工作时开着 watch 模式或编辑器 hooks

steps.en: Only changed files and their dependents get re-parsed
steps.zh: 只重解析变更文件和它们的依赖方

steps.en: Ask the agent about impact; it calls the MCP tools
steps.zh: 问 agent 影响面，它去调 MCP 工具

steps.en: Answers with a compact blast-radius slice instead of raw source
steps.zh: 回交紧凑的 blast-radius 切片而非原始源码

value.en: The agent reads only the files a change touches — its benchmark reports ~63x median token reduction per question
value.zh: agent 只读改动波及的文件——其基准自报每问题 token 中位缩减约 63 倍
